name: Bobok
source:
1873. St. Petersburg.
Not the most prominent literary man was dubbed in newspapers as a madman. His portrait with two phenomenally symmetrical and lively warts was to blame! Unheard of human stupidity surrounds the writer.
Wishing to divert himself, he enters a funeral where he begins to hear the voices of undead people... Maybe at least they are smarter than living ones?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1873年。圣彼得堡。
没有哪个最著名的文学家被报纸称为疯子。罪魁祸首是他的肖像画上有两个极其对称且活泼的疣！作家周围有闻所未闻的人类愚蠢行为。
为了分散自己的注意力，他进入了一场葬礼，在那里他开始听到不死人的声音……也许至少他们比活人更聪明？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783510/]Steam[/url]]
